text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, July 7 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - Berth vacant. 5 Vessels due by 27/7, no delays.
Hay Point - Maintenance shutdown of berth no.2 10/6-8/7. One vessel loading, 5 waiting, 10 due 21/7, no delays.
Dalrymple Bay - Two vessels loading, 3 waiting, 18 due by 25/7, no delays.
R.G. Tanna - 1 Vessel loading, 1 waiting, 23 due by 20/8, no delays.
Barney Point - 1 Vessel loading, 5 due by 20/8, no delays.
Brisbane - Berth vacant. 3 Vessels due by 29/7, no delays.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Industrial unrest at Hunter Valley Coal and Allied no.1 so far not affecting coal loadings, but expected to do so later.
Kooragang - 2 Vessels loading, 22 waiting, 9 due by 13/7. 13-14 Days delay expected.
Dykes 4+5 - 1 Vessel loading, 14 waiting, 13 due by 15/7. 10-11 Days delay expected.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading, 1 waiting, 22 due by 28/8, no delays.

IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Due to the occasional shortage of Mt. Newman and Yandi fines, iron ore vessels may experience some berthing/loading delays or be forced to berth out of turn.
A berth - 1 Vessel loading, 2 anchored, 2 due by 7/8.

B berth - 1 Vessel loading, 3 anchored, 16 other vessels due by 21/7, no eta received, bhp iron ore pty. ltd., goldsworthy (finucane island) - 4 vessels due by 21/7. dampier - parker point - 1 vessel loading, 6 anchored, 1 vessel due by 8/7, east intercourse island - 1 vessel loading, 5 anchored, 1 vessel due by 8/7, dampier line-up - 21 vessels due by 19/7 of which 15 for parker point, 6 for east intercourse island. porwalcott - one vessel loading, 1 berthed, 3 anchored, 9 vessels due by 29/7. grain - 9 July - queensland - mackay - no vessels due. gladstone - one vessel due 18/7 to load sun flowers. brisbane - one vessel loading wheat. new south wales - newcastle - four vessels due by 21/7 of which 3 to load wheat, 1 barley. sydney - no further grain loading expected at this port. port kembla - one vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load wheat, 3 vessels due by 22/7, all to load wheat. berthing progrme based on grade of cargo received by rail. grain terminal closed for maintenance 11-16/7. victoria - gee
